presets.name: Bare
presets.description: The style stripped back: the texture overlay switched off for a flat, clean face plate.

presets.name: Sepia
presets.summary: A brass robot on tanned metal.
presets.description: The whole robot is drawn on the background here, so one palette change carries the picture. Seven eye sets and one mouth carry a color painted into the artwork rather than exposed as a group, so those variants drop out.

presets.name: Greyscale
presets.summary: Bare metal, four steps of grey.
presets.description: Grey suits the subject better than most styles: a robot in steel is not a compromise. Seven eye sets and one mouth carry a color painted into the artwork rather than exposed as a group, so those variants drop out.

presets.name: Duotone
presets.summary: One indigo for the whole face.
presets.description: A single hue, which is the most restrained this style gets and the easiest to place next to an existing brand color. Seven eye sets and one mouth carry a color painted into the artwork rather than exposed as a group, so those variants drop out.

presets.name: Muted
presets.summary: An earthy shell instead of the bright one.
presets.description: The style ships 22 saturated colors. Six earthy ones turn the robots from toys into equipment. Seven eye sets and one mouth carry a color painted into the artwork rather than exposed as a group, so those variants drop out.

presets.name: Electric
presets.description: The other direction: six colors past anything the style ships. The LEDs and hearts stay, because loud is the point here.

presets.name: Pastel Wall
presets.description: The lightest way to make a set of avatars feel like it belongs together.

presets.name: Bold Pop
presets.description: The loud counterpart to Pastel Wall, strong enough that the avatar holds its own against a busy page.

presets.name: Sunrise
presets.summary: A warm gradient across the face plate.
presets.description: Shows the gradient background options: two colors, a linear fill and a fixed angle.

presets.name: Full Cast
presets.summary: Every robot gets the surface texture.
presets.description: The texture overlay sits at fifty percent, so half the robots come out flat. This puts it on all of them, which makes a set read as one production run.

presets.name: Close Up
presets.summary: Scaled in on the face plate.
presets.description: Uses scale rather than color. At the size a comment thread gives an avatar, cropping in buys back the eyes and mouth.
